diagnostics.message: null_resource.delete_http_listener must depend on null_resource.delete_frontend_port so Terraform's reverse destroy ordering runs the listener deletion before deleting its referenced frontend port. The existing dependency on set_frontend_port does not order the separate delete_frontend_port destroy provisioner.

null_resource.delete_http_settings must depend on null_resource.delete_probe so Terraform's reverse destroy ordering removes HTTP settings before deleting their referenced probes. The existing dependency on set_probe does not order the separate delete_probe destroy provisioner.
